title: Edit your Business Profile - Google Business Profile Help

facts.fact: Beyond the primary category, a business can select up to 9 more categories on its Business Profile.
facts.quote: You can select up to 9 more categories.

facts.fact: Beyond the primary business phone number, a Business Profile can list up to 2 more phone numbers, which can be mobile or landline but not fax.
facts.quote: you can enter up to 2 more phone numbers. They can be mobile numbers or landline, but not fax.

facts.fact: Google may occasionally contact the verified phone number on a Business Profile using automated calls, texts, or WhatsApp to confirm business info, a feature that is currently available only in select regions, languages, and business categories.
facts.quote: This feature is currently available for select regions, languages, and business categories and may not be available for all users.

facts.fact: Deleting collected information removes it from Google's records but does not change other details already on the Business Profile.
facts.quote: Deleting collected information removes it from Google's records but does not change other details already on your Business Profile.

facts.fact: If a business changes its name after the Business Profile is verified, it might need to verify the business again.
facts.quote: If you change your business name after it’s verified, you might need to verify your business again.

facts.fact: If a business moves to a new address after its Business Profile is verified, it must verify the business again.
facts.quote: If you move your business to a new address after it’s verified, you must verify your business again.
